summary.zh: 规定开始工作前先查并调用匹配的技能
summary.en: Rules for finding and invoking matching skills before work.

description.zh: 明确在回答或动手之前先检索并调用适用的技能，给出多个技能同时匹配时的取舍顺序，也点出常见的自我开脱想法。适合希望把技能使用变成固定习惯的团队。
description.en: Sets the habit of searching for and invoking a fitting skill before answering or acting, with an ordering rule when several apply and a list of the rationalisations that lead people to skip them. For teams wanting that habit to hold.
